trial.name: Marauder MAD-3R — low-resolution silhouette
trial.notes: Shape-first reference study of Catalyst-era MAD-3R. The low narrow beak, flattened carapace, dorsal AC/5, horizontal PPC forearms, raised hip joints, and backward knee silhouette are the priority. X right; -Z front. Distinct mirrored long PPC barrel subassemblies, low forward head chin and genuinely bored dorsal autocannon, without adding false torso volume or extra arms.

trial.name: Phoenix Hawk PXH-1 — shape study

The smaller forward machine-gun emitter has its own rigid attachment instead of relying on a long bridge through the large-laser barrel.
